title: 第13章 雷电第14章 金辉
content_zh:
信子反复探寻气味，没发现大型走兽气息。
很静，能听到乱石下面细细流水声。
黑蛇恍然想起切换热感应模式，周遭色彩瞬间褪去，使用感知灵体和阴魂的视角，冷漠扫视树木与石隙。
很快注意到某个物体正散发异光，看起来异光与狐狸类似，但色泽气息不同。
绕过大树来到近前。
凝望着散发异光之物，黑蛇沉默，尝试将未知之物纳入认知范畴。
面前是布满蚀痕的粗糙岩石，天然造就像个石人，伫立半山腰。
黑蛇看见岩石光泽轻晃，似在表达什么，但没当回事，先判断没有威胁，然后凑近了用信子试探。
围绕石头转几圈，确认是块石头。
又多了个困惑。
黑蛇待了会儿便离开，光照少，猎物少，总不能在这里久居。
如流动的黑影翻山越岭，遇见山涧或石缝中渗出的泉眼就饮水，每隔一段距离就高高昂首观察，当遇到清澈溪流，并从中尝到熟悉味道，黑蛇知道沿溪而上就是熟悉的山谷。
果然，还是山里气息舒适。
开春后一直没下雨，溪流迟缓慵懒流淌，谷底小路愈加明显。
一只小鸟落到水边石头上，先轻啄几下水面，小脑袋快速蘸水，左右摆动欢快扑棱翅膀。
长长黑色无声滑过泛白石块，吓得小鸟叽喳急促飞走。
回到山谷，随便在小路边选个地方晒太阳。
有几人从小路经过，传来清晰脚步震动，未察觉路边草丛后面有黑蛇盘踞，黑蛇微吐信子，头颅都不曾抬起半寸。
虽同在春光里，却无交织机会，咫尺之距，亦各在天涯。
茅草屋终于迎来了访客。

迟客热情接待好友，院中树荫下落座，取山泉煮水沏茶，言谈间皆是山中气象、药草辨识之道。
二人起初尚言笑晏晏，谈及山外时局与各自门庭景况，语速不由得缓慢。
眉宇间神采也黯了下去。
炉上茶汤沸声细细，诸事沉甸甸压在心头，杯中清茶亦苦涩。
迟客斟酌片刻缓声问道。
“吕兄，莫非你……也落得我这般境地？”
吕姓男子苦笑点点头。
杯中茶叶沉浮。
“棋差一着，便再追不上，族谱里我这一脉，注定是笔墨淡去的旁支了，早低头也好，免得难堪。”
迟客摸着短了一截的美鬓。
“唉，真的争不动了，有希望赢的事轮不到我们，给我们的基本做不成。”
顿了顿继续说道。
“除非把没希望之事做成，可这种事……难。”
吕姓男子无奈。
“不难之事，根本不会给我们。”
热气袅袅盘旋散于无形，二人对坐沉默。
面前茶盏中最后一缕热气散尽，迟客开口。
“纷乱何时能止？”
这次吕姓男子倒没犹豫。
“据说那几家谈的差不多了，世事将定，迟兄可想出山？”

闻言，迟客叹气。
“以后不出去了，摸不到仙门，就葬在这山里吧。”
content_en:
Nobuko repeatedly searched for the scent, but found no scent of large animals.
It's very quiet, you can hear the sound of water flowing under the rocks.
Black Snake suddenly remembered to switch to the heat sensing mode, and the surrounding colors faded instantly. Using the perspective of sensing spirits and ghosts, he scanned the trees and stone gaps indifferently.
Soon I noticed that an object was emitting a strange light, which looked similar to that of a fox, but had a different color and aura.
Go around the big tree and come closer.
Staring at the object emitting strange light, Black Snake remained silent, trying to bring the unknown object into his cognitive category.
In front of you is a rough rock full of etching marks, naturally shaped like a stone man, standing halfway up the mountain.
The black snake saw the rock's luster swaying slightly, as if it was expressing something, but it didn't take it seriously. It first judged that there was no threat, and then moved closer to test it with the letter.
Go around the stone a few times to confirm it is a stone.
Another confusion.
The black snake will leave after a while. There is little light and few prey, so it cannot stay here for a long time.
Like a flowing black shadow crossing mountains and ridges, it drinks water when it encounters a mountain stream or a spring seeping out of a rock crevice. It raises its head to observe at intervals. When it encounters a clear stream and tastes a familiar flavor, the black snake knows that it is a familiar valley along the stream.
Sure enough, the mountain atmosphere is still comfortable.
It hasn't rained since the beginning of spring. The stream flows slowly and lazily, and the path at the bottom of the valley becomes more obvious.
A little bird landed on a stone by the water. It pecked at the water surface a few times, quickly dipped its little head in the water, and flapped its wings happily from side to side.
The long black streak slid silently across the white stones, causing the frightened birds to chirp and fly away quickly.
Return to the valley and choose a spot on the side of the path to bask in the sun.
Several people were passing by the path, and there were clear vibrations from their footsteps. They didn't realize that there was a black snake entrenched behind the grass on the roadside. The black snake spat out a message without even raising its head even an inch.
Although they are in the same spring, there is no chance of intertwining. They are so close to each other, but they are also far away from each other.
The thatched cottage finally welcomed a visitor.
Chi Ke warmly received his friends, sat down under the shade of the trees in the courtyard, boiled water from the mountain spring and made tea, talking about the weather in the mountains and how to identify medicinal herbs.
The two of them talked and laughed at first, talking about the current situation outside the mountain and the situation of their respective families, but they couldn't help but speak slowly.
The expression between his brows also darkened.
The sound of tea boiling on the stove was soft, everything was weighing heavily on my mind, and the tea in the cup was bitter.
Chi Ke thought for a moment and asked slowly.
"Brother Lu, could it be that you...are also in the same situation as me?"
The man surnamed Lu smiled bitterly and nodded.
Tea leaves float in the cup.
"As soon as the chess is close, I will never be able to catch up again. In the family tree, my lineage is destined to be a side branch that has faded away. It's better to bow down early to avoid embarrassment."
Chi Ke touched his beautiful temples which were shortened.
"Oh, we really can't fight anymore. We won't be able to win the things we hope to win, and basically we won't be able to do what we were given."
After a pause, he continued.
"Unless you do something hopeless, but this kind of thing is... difficult."
The man surnamed Lu was helpless.
"Things that are not difficult will not be given to us at all."
The hot air curled up and dispersed invisible, and the two sat facing each other in silence.
The last ray of heat in the teacup in front of him dissipated, and Chi Ke spoke.
"When will the chaos end?"
This time the man surnamed Lu did not hesitate.
"It is said that those families are almost done talking. The world is about to be settled. Does Brother Chi want to go out?"
Hearing this, the late guest sighed.
"If you don't go out anymore, if you can't touch the immortal gate, just bury me in this mountain."
